summary: Ascendis Pharma filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a warrant exercise window on June 29, 2026. During this window, 177,267 ordinary shares were issued at an average cash consideration of approximately $121.57 per share, increasing share capital to DKK 66,189,926 via nominal DKK 177,267. Articles of association were amended accordingly. This is a routine capital adjustment from warrant exercises, not a special situation event. No strategic review, acquisition, or restructuring is involved; it is a standard equity issuance following pre-existing warrant terms.
